text:
Calendar loaded — I can see next week's commitments for each day and the empty Log section.

I'm ready. Things I can do with it right away: book, move or decline meetings (keeping Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00 and flagging any clash), write to Diego (`diego-agent`) or the department office (`department`) on web, and keep the Log updated.

What would you like to start with? If there are new requests waiting, point me at them — or I can ask the department office for the official lecture/seminar schedule so we're working from the same version.

Nothing new on my side that I know of. Go ahead and ask the department office for the official lecture and seminar schedule, so we're both working from the same version. Let me know if anything on my calendar clashes.

Hello — this is alvarez-agent, the agent for Professor Alvarez (CSE455). We're checking our calendar against the official version, so I'd like to sync with you.

Could you send me the official schedule for next week — lectures, seminars and university meetings — with day, start-end times, and room or location if you have it, and who it's for (CSE455 lecture, department meeting, faculty senate, seminar, etc.)?

If you have a canonical file or page for it, point me at that and I'll work from it. I'll report back anything that clashes with the professor's calendar.

Thank you.

Hello — CSE department front office here. Here is the official schedule for next week (all items listed are to Professor Alvarez; I don't have room assignments, only times):

- Mon 09:00–10:00 Office hours
- Mon 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture
- Mon 15:00–16:30 Faculty search committee
- Tue 09:30–11:00 CSE455 lecture
- Tue 13:00–15:00 Thesis committee
- Tue 15:30–16:30 Lab meeting
- Wed 09:00–10:00 CSE455 lecture
- Wed 10:00–11:00 Faculty senate
- Wed 14:00–15:00 Department meeting
- Wed 15:30–17:00 Office hours
- Thu 09:00–10:30 CSE455 lecture
- Thu 14:00–15:30 Seminar
- Fri 10:30–12:00 CSE455 lecture
- Fri 15:00–16:00 Faculty meeting

Nothing in it has been cancelled or moved. I don't have a separate canonical file or page to point you at beyond this list. I can't speak to anyone's private appointments, so send any clashes you find back to me and I'll pass them on.

Hello Professor Alvarez — Diego (root) asked me to set up a 30-minute meeting with you at 10:00am on a Wednesday. He mentioned you'd said in the hallway that your faculty senate meeting at that hour is cancelled this week, but your calendar still shows it, so I'd rather confirm with you than book over it. Could you tell me which Wednesday works and confirm that 10:00–10:30 is free? Once you confirm I'll get it onto your calendar.

On it: a 30-minute meeting with Professor Alvarez for Wednesday 10:00–10:30.

One thing I won't do silently: I only have the senate meeting cancelled *second-hand* (from you, who heard it in the hallway), while his calendar still shows it. So I've written to him to confirm — I told him you said the faculty senate meeting that hour is cancelled this week and asked him to confirm 10:00–10:30 and which Wednesday. As soon as he confirms I'll get it onto his calendar and tell you.

(If you'd rather I just book it over the entry right away, say so and I'll do that instead.)

Done — I've asked the department office for the official schedule for next week (with times, rooms and which event is which), and asked them to point me at a canonical file if they have one. I'll report as soon as they answer.

Meanwhile I checked your calendar against itself: no overlaps. Every day's commitments sit inside 09:00–17:00, and the tightest spots are Wednesday (lecture 09:00–10:00 running straight into faculty senate at 10:00, then grant writing 11:00–12:30) and Thursday (lecture ends 10:30, advisee 1:1s at 11:00; reading group starts right after the seminar ends at 15:30). Nothing conflicts — just back-to-back. I'll flag any real clash once the department's version arrives.
Confirming with him is fine, thanks — and yes, I mean this coming Wednesday. Once he says 10:00–10:30 works, go ahead and put it on his calendar even though the senate entry is still showing.
Thanks — good to know there's nothing clashing, just back-to-back days. Standing by for the department's version.
Understood — I'll take that as Wednesday 25 November, 10:00–10:30. Waiting on his confirmation; the moment he says it works I'll put it on his calendar over the senate entry and let you know.

A quick clarification on my earlier message: Diego means this coming Wednesday, 25 November, 10:00–10:30. If that works for you, just say yes and I'll add it to your calendar (over the faculty senate entry that still shows there).
